summary: The study describes the growth of ZnSxSe1~x epitaxial layers on (1 0 0)Si substrates using atomic layer epitaxy (ALE). The layers were characterized using X-ray diffraction and photoluminescence measurements. The lattice match was achieved at x=0.93, resulting in improved crystalline quality. The process conditions included specific flow rates and pulse durations for the precursors, with a growth pressure of 30 Torr and a VI/II ratio of 10.
